value.rationale: The result connects two natural indicators of isolation and patterned connectivity, exhibits a model-dependent sign reversal, and gives a shape-universal single-crossing tree-size threshold with nontrivial macroscopic constant. These features provide more than marginal first moments or an unmotivated small integer calculation; they identify a structural null-model distinction and a sharp limit of its range.
